title: 西爽村 Xi Shuang Cun
subtitle: Qichun Yuan

model.line: 9 boxes stand in this compound, 9 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 嘉庆 《题清夏斋》 自注 (as quoted in S220)
evidence.locator: S220 section 一; primary not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 是斋在西爽村，原额‘凤麟洲’本非宸翰所题，曾经皇考赐成亲王居此。
evidence.summary: Jiaqing's note: the studio stands in 西爽村; its old plaque read 凤麟洲, not in an imperial hand, and the Qianlong emperor had given it to Prince Cheng. So the name 凤麟洲 first belonged here, before the later island QC06 of 1807.

evidence.title: 嘉庆十三年 谕旨 on 西爽村 (as quoted in S220)
evidence.locator: S220 section 一; archive not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 西爽村着仍称绮春园宫门（即绮春园西宫门），嗣后一切称谓书写，俱不得再有西爽村字样。
evidence.summary: The name 西爽村 is to be dropped in favour of the west gate of the garden. The bracket is the modern author's gloss. S220 puts 西爽村 in the area of the later 延英论道 QC28: a position hint for QC28 near QC61.

evidence.title: 嘉庆 《含辉楼远望》 自注 (as quoted in S220)
evidence.locator: S220 section 四; primary not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 绮春园内之西南偏，旧以缭墙别界一区，名曰含晖园。又横界一区，名曰西爽村。中有联辉楼，为成亲王寓园憩止之所。
evidence.summary: In the south-west of the garden a walled area was once 含晖园 and another, set across it, 西爽村, with 联辉楼 Lianhui Lou where Prince Cheng rested.

evidence.title: 清稗類鈔 宮苑類 綺春園
evidence.excerpt_zh: 绮春园含晖园在圆明园东，有复道相属，仁宗三女庄敬公主厘降时，赐居于此。公主薨，额驸索特那木多尔济照例缴进，又以成哲亲王寓园西爽村均并入绮春园中。道光时，宣宗尊养孝和后于绮春园，文宗初元，亦奉孝静后居此，问安视膳，一如道光间礼.盖文宗幼时失母，为孝静所抚育，故即位后孝静由康慈皇贵太妃尊为太后也。咸丰庚申淀园之灾，绮春亦同归煨烬矣。
evidence.summary: How 綺春園 grew: 含暉園 joined by a covered way for the princess, handed back at her death, with 西爽村 added. Consorts lived there under Daoguang and Xianfeng, and it burned with the rest in 1860.

evidence.title: 清稗類鈔 宮苑類 綺春園 (repeats S223 in part)
evidence.locator: zh.wikisource 清稗類鈔/005, 綺春園
evidence.excerpt_zh: 含暉園在圓明園東，有複道相屬，仁宗三女莊敬公主釐降時，賜居於此。公主薨，額駙索特那木多爾濟照例繳進，又以成哲親王寓園西爽村均併入綺春園中。道光時，宣宗尊養孝和后於綺春園，文宗初元，亦奉孝靜后居此，問安視膳，一如道光間禮。蓋文宗幼時失母，為孝靜所撫育，故即位後孝靜由康慈皇貴太妃尊為太后也。咸豐庚申淀園之災，綺春亦同歸煨燼矣。
evidence.summary: A later compiler's digest of the same story as S223, with Kangci named as 孝靜.

evidence.title: 《養吉齋叢錄》 on 綺春園 and the Thirty Scenes
evidence.date: Qing; text states events up to 文宗
evidence.excerpt_zh: 綺春園在圓明園東，有複道相屬。舊為大學士傅恆及其子大學士福康安賜園，歿後繳進，嘉慶間始加繕葺。仁宗御製綺春園三十景詩，有宣宗恭跋：先是，園西南以繚垣別界一區，名含暉園，莊敬和碩公主釐降時，賜居於此。公主薨逝，額駙索特那木多布齋以園繳進。舊又橫界一區，名西爽村，有聯暉樓，為成邸寓園。嘉慶間成邸別賜園宅，西爽、含暉皆併入為一園，而規模宏遠矣。舊有數楹名鳳麐洲，後易名清夏齋；問月樓在洲之南，鏡綠亭在洲之北。道光時為尊養孝和皇太后之所，正殿曰迎暉殿。文宗登極，奉康慈太后亦居此，問安視膳，皆如道光間禮。三十景者：敷春堂　鑑德書屋　翠合軒　凌虛閣　協性齋　澄光榭　問月樓　我見室　蔚藻堂　藹芳圃　鏡綠亭　淙玉軒　舒卉軒　竹林院　夕霏榭　清夏齋　鏡虹館　春雨山房　含光樓（即舊時聯暉樓）　涵清館　華滋庭　苔香室　虛明鏡　含淳堂　春澤齋　水心榭　四宜書屋　茗柯精舍　來薰室　般若觀
evidence.summary: The earliest list of the Thirty Scenes we can see, and the history before it seems to come from Daoguang's colophon to Jiaqing's poem set (有宣宗恭跋). It places 問月樓 south of 洲 and 鏡綠亭 north of it, names 迎暉殿 as the main hall of the dowager's residence, and equates 含光樓 with the old 聯暉樓. Punctuation is ours; the print has none. Transcribed by eye.

evidence.title: 毕沅 《春和园纪游》 西爽村 诗序 (as quoted in S220)
evidence.date: 乾隆; S220 gives no year. Describes Fuheng's garden, so before he gave it up
evidence.locator: S220 section 一; primary not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 西爽村秋原如画，遥缅凤城，楼阁隐见浮岚暖翠中。公平旦趋朝，每由园西角门入左掖垣。
evidence.summary: West of the garden, open autumn fields with a view to the capital; Fuheng left by the west corner gate for court. S220's bracket gloss is removed.

evidence.title: 内务府 repair list 乾隆五十六年 (as quoted in S220)
evidence.locator: S220 section 三; archive not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 涵远斋东顺山房一座三间，两山游廊二座六间 ... 联晖楼后檐拆盖听雨屋殿一座三间，撷秀山房（在西爽村）后檐粘补五抹槅扇一槽，拆修平台码头一座，拆砌虎皮石大墙三段 ... 修葺明善堂东山游廊一座八间，……眺吟楼一座三间
evidence.summary: Bay counts, in the older state. The bracket is the modern author's. 眺吟楼 is three bays. The two parts of the quotation are separate lists in S220.

evidence.title: 绮春园 宫门 names (as quoted in S220)
evidence.date: 嘉庆十三年 1808; 同治十二年 1873
evidence.locator: S220, passage on the 嘉庆十三年 edict; section 五
evidence.excerpt_zh: 西爽村着仍称绮春园宫门（即绮春园西宫门），嗣后一切称谓书写，俱不得再有西爽村字样
evidence.summary: An edict makes 西爽村 the west gate of the garden. In 1873 the west gate by 清夏斋 becomes 南宫门. S01's 西爽村宫门 fits the first and has not the name of the second.

evidence.title: 含光楼 (绮春园三十景)
evidence.excerpt_zh: 含光楼 旧名联辉楼，为十一兄住居。联辉昔日雁行聚，鸿影翩翻云路高。柳下分堋同较射，花间觅句共挥毫。清谈犹忆凭朱槛，嘉树还看荫碧皋。偶憩棠阴怀旧雨，绿杨溪畔放轻舠。
evidence.summary: One of the Thirty Scenes by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1805, the thirtieth: its title says the tower was once 联辉楼, home of his eleventh elder brother (Prince Cheng), before the move to 含辉楼.

evidence.title: 含辉楼: 嘉庆十七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆十七年 (1812), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 别墅初开生面新，绮春旧境迹仍陈。迁乔欣接飞鸿影（绮春园内之西南偏，旧以缭墙别界一区，名曰含晖园，又横界一区，名曰西爽村，中有联辉楼为成亲王寓园憩止之所，予经帷之暇，亦常拈吟较射于其中，后成亲王经予别赐园宅，迁移巳逾十稔矣。），厘降怆飘野马尘（嗣以庄敬和硕公主下降，亦曾赐居含晖园，去岁公主病逝，复经额驸索特那木多布斋呈缴。）。
evidence.summary: Jiaqing, 1812, the fullest history of this corner: his note says 含晖园 and 西爽村 were walled off inside 绮春园, with 联辉楼 lent to Prince Cheng, then to Princess Zhuangjing, returned after her death.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 绮春园
evidence.summary: Formed from princes' and ministers' gardens, about 54.3 ha. Taken back from Fuheng's heirs and renamed in 1769; gate, tiger-stone wall and 正觉寺 added by 1773, rebuilt in 1795. Jiaqing's growth came in three stages: the western and central groups of the Thirty Scenes first, then the new gate and eastern scenes, finally the south-west (招凉榭, 湛清轩, 畅和堂, 澄心堂, the shrines), gathered as a New Twenty Scenes.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
